title: Work details: focus and reveal the drawer on open
outcome: Round-1 Claude Low, WorkItemDetails.tsx:60: opening leaves focus on the row, so aside-only Escape is unreachable without tabbing; details below a long table may be offscreen without announcement. Focus a suitable drawer control/heading, reveal it, and restore row focus on close. Existing test dispatches Escape directly to aside and does not model actual focus.
acceptance: Keyboard activation places focus in visible details; Escape from the focused control closes and restores the triggering row; cover long table and missing trigger cases without stealing later user focus.
